name: quote-stack
title: Quote stack
description: Short lines of praise set as large type and stacked down the page with small attributions; the line you point at stays at full strength.
docs: Pass title and quotes ({ id, quote, name, role }); four to six one-sentence quotes under fifteen words each read best. On a wide screen the quotes alternate between the left and the right two thirds of the width; on a phone they sit in one left-aligned column. While the pointer is over one quote, or keyboard focus is on it, the others dim to 40 percent with a CSS selector on the list: no script, no motion, and on a touch screen everything stays at full strength. A quote and the air around it are one hover target, so the pointer hands over from one quote to the next and the stack never flashes back to full strength in between. Each quote is in the tab order unless focusable is false. It is a real list of figures that reads in any order.
